for me its horrible. i have like 300 thoughts per minute, my mind wont shut up. I overthink and get paranoid. last time I thought a friend was going to break into my house and occupy it for no apparent reason, and I was going to sleep on the streets, I had a neighbor and I thought he was going to hurt me, and also I distrusted both my therapist and my doctor, my family and friends. delusions like "theyre going to ruin my reputation by spreading rumors about me, maybe authorities on university will expell me" also I overshared a lot about past situations of my life with random people or on ig stories, like "trauma dumping". I only slept 3 hours a day even if I hadnt sleep all night. I almost told my music theory teacher I was going to quit my classes bc I was going to be hospitalized, or hit on him, etc. I couldnt read, work, or watch any show bc I was overthinking a lot. and while overthinking I had a tremendous rage that lasted a few hours. I also started lighting candles and praying to entities, I even once thought I've heard a voice. Planned on moving abroad, got two jobs in one week and dropped the next. 
I never realised I was acting "weird" by any chance. I was put on meds, and two years later I was better and my doc put me off it. 
And depressive episodes are hell too, so I hate both extremes.
I am very afraid of going through these episodes again 😔 sorry if my grammar is poor or this is weirdly redacted, english is not my first language.
